## The Healthcare Staffing Challenge

Healthcare staffing agencies focus on clinical roles, but you also need qualified administrative and revenue cycle professionals who understand healthcare operations.

HIPAA compliance, credentialing verification, and healthcare-specific background checks are non-negotiable—but they slow down traditional hiring processes.

Seasonal volume fluctuations, new service line launches, and regulatory changes create staffing needs that don't fit permanent headcount planning.

### The TaasFlow Solution

- Medical coders, billers, and revenue cycle specialists with certification verification
- Practice managers and healthcare administrators with health system experience
- All candidates HIPAA-trained and background check-ready
- Understanding of Epic, Cerner, and other major EHR/EMR systems
- Flexible engagements for seasonal volume, new programs, or temporary coverage
